  PROBLEM: The ShellCheck CI job falls back to the runner's unpinned shellcheck binary if the pinned version install fails or the binary is missing.
  WHY: If the fallback binary is an older version (0.9.x), it ignores the file-wide `# shellcheck extended-analysis=false` directive (SC1107). Consequently, it performs the expensive dataflow analysis that causes the runner to shut down, causing the CI job to fail again, even though the intended fix was applied.
